made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/sala_dia-sheet-make.js, from sala_dia-set.html (window.SALA_DIA.E) and the design of La sala, de día (the orchestrator's p9-spec, general rules and section sala_dia). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 66. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the back wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 66 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62. The seats are the set's own: the cushions E.CUSHIONS (cojin1 (-0.4,3.5), cojin2 (0.8,3.5), tops z 0.12), the desk's chair E.DESKSEAT (-2.3,0.95), the armchair E.ARMCHAIR (2.75,2.7), tops z 0.44
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.12: a cushion's top; z 0.44: a chair's or the armchair's top; z 0.4: the low table's top; z 0.55: the small table's top) and, drawn there, a character stands (or, who sits, is hung by the lap) with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the book, the pad, the telephone, the three pages and the box of stars have their bottom middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]); the photo's spot is cojin2's lifted 8 px (z + 8 / 22.5); abuelo's ear and mouth are boxes on his drawn head (the spots oreja_abuelo and boca_abuelo: their screen point is the box's middle, their uv a point on the plane of his sprite through his lap). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. abuela standing, mkAbuela (48 wide): column 30 (her middle), its lowest drawn row; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); whoever sits, mkPersona with sent = 1 (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX) and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41; t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat's top; a small thing: see spot. Nobody is drawn turned: whoever sits faces us
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the low table hides the lap and legs of the children on the cushions, the desk hides Luis from the lap down, the armchair's arms hide the edges of abuelo.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where the set's baked depth (window.DEPTH.z of the set page) bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias. The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28)
